prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Generate one replacement LORE TCG interior illustration, approximately 1472x1344, no lettering or card frame. Image 1 is the authoritative illustration style: the delicate drawn contours, selectively simplified shapes and painterly colored shadow planes of the elf illustration. Apply that exact DRAWN character treatment to the DOG and to the background. Image 2 is the rejected dog design, use ONLY to retain dog identity, markings and setting. The rejected dog's photographic fur and photographic face MUST be completely replaced.
The whole finished image must clearly be a hand-drawn fantasy game illustration: fine intentional contour lines, grouped sculpted fur locks with clean designed edges, broad painted light/shadow planes, expressive simplified dark eyes with one modest highlight, a simplified matte black nose and a gracefully designed muzzle. Do not draw thousands of individually realistic hairs, nose pores, wet photographic specular detail, camera bokeh, lens depth of field or photoreal lighting. Medium stylization appropriate to image 1; not a photo filter, not a plush toy, not chibi, not a mascot logo or children's cartoon. Refined, warm character presence, painted fantasy atmosphere. Dog stays entirely canine with four legs, no clothing, humanoid limbs, horns, wings or armor. Face and main silhouette central with framing margin. The dog and setting must use one consistent drawn illustration technique.
Subject: Winter, a larger shaggy white-and-gray companion dog with white face and muzzle, a charcoal-gray patch over viewer-right eye/ear, gray saddle back, long white forelegs and big fluffy paws. Friendly open mouth and a small pink tongue, floppy ears. Preserve these marking locations and the long-legged soft silhouette of second image. Render shaggy fur as larger stylized flowing white/gray locks, separated by delicate drawn contour lines and lavender-blue painted shadow shapes; NO microhairs. Standing with one forepaw on a snowy fallen tree beside a turquoise frozen stream. Painted dark conifer silhouettes, muted lavender winter sky and one restrained aurora ribbon. Subtle pale blue spirit light at paws and tail. Snow and ice illustrated with designed facets and broad brush planes, no photographic snow texture. Refined illustrative animal character with the same flat-drawn facial treatment as the elf style reference.
